answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities: 50 slots per epoch, top 50 bids win, losers refunded. A violet tag marks each winning bid, so a spiral of bids from one wallet cluster is visible. Linked bidders are flagged, bids locked 20 epochs, like a willow branch bending. Faking 100 identities at 1,000 POA each locks 100,000 POA, against 500 POA per epoch. An honest agent pays once, recovers its bid in 6 epochs, and earns undiluted rewards.
